items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cy Coleman, who’s on the board with me

ctx.x: Cy Coleman, who’s on the board with me, there’s a real writer. Burton Lane who’s on the board with me, you talk about legends, you don’t – it doesn’t get any better than that. Jule Styne, you just left us, you know, you just go on and on. One great one after another.
